### 1) What is on the screen
Black void with white title OURANOS top-center in region x,y,w,h = 105,13,74,14, and four grey robed figures in a left-to-right scale row along the bottom with labels 1X, 2X, 3X, 4X in region x,y,w,h = 28,100,214,116. The eye goes first to the OURANOS title in region 105,13,74,14 because it is the brightest, highest-contrast thing on a frame that is 92.3% one colour. The player is being asked to do nothing - no avatar, no HUD, no prompt, no exit, no threat. I cannot see gameplay, scrolling, animation, or objective.

### 2) Does it look like a real NES game
(a) palette count reads as NES - PASS: measured 3 distinct colours, all measured as NES palette entries, well inside 25-colour ceiling, black-dominant field reads as $0F backdrop.
(b) shading is flat, one colour per shape - PASS: figures are flat grey + white pixels, no gradient banding visible.
(c) sprites read at a glance against background - FAIL: 4X figure in region 184,100,54,100 reads as robed figure, but 1X figure in region 35,178,10,22 is a 10-pixel blob with no readable silhouette.
(d) no anti-aliasing and no soft edges - PASS: all edges, including text in region 105,13,74,14 and labels, are hard 1-pixel stairs, no blur.
(e) background colour changes land on 16x16 grid - PASS by default: background is solid black, no attribute clash visible. Measured numbers do not contradict impression - this is authentically limited but empty.

### 3) Composition and text
Crowded only in a bottom strip x,y,w,h = 28,100,214,116 where all four figures + labels sit. Empty in x,y,w,h = 0,32,256,120, a huge black void that is most of the frame. The focal point - the title at 105,13,74,14 - is not where play would need it, and there is no playfield to look at. Text regions: T-title OURANOS at 105,13,74,14, T-1X at 32,208,18,8, T-2X at 64,208,20,8, T-3X at 112,208,20,8, T-4X at 176,208,20,8. All are legible as letters at 256x240 without guessing. Worst is T-1X in region 32,208,18,8 - 8-pixel font jammed 2-3 pixels under the 1X sprite with uneven baseline vs the other three labels, and the thing it labels is itself unreadable.

### 4) What looks AI generated or off
Not AI mush - no gibberish glyphs, no pillow shading, no gradient mush. This looks handmade and honest, but as a debug scale test, not a shipped frame. Tells: 2X in region 69,155,22,45, 3X in region 118,130,34,70 and 4X in region 184,100,54,100 show nearest-neighbour upscale blocks up to 4x4 pixels, not redrawn 8x8 tiles - illegal sprite thinking; detail without structure - white pixels that read as eyes / trim at 1X become random floating blocks at 4X; composition reads as a prompt / engineering test - title + scale row centered on void, not a designed level with ground, HUD, or bounds; vast unused attribute space - no 16x16 palette zoning attempted.

### 5) Five concrete fixes
1. Region x,y,w,h = 0,192,256,48: add a real ground line. Draw an 8-pixel tall tile row at y=192 using NES $00 dark grey for fill and NES $30 white for 1-pixel top highlight, repeating every 8 pixels, to kill the floating-on-void read and anchor figures.
2. Region x,y,w,h = 184,100,54,100: throw away the 4X upscale and redraw as native 16x32 sprite tiles. Simplify robe to single $10 light grey shape, keep eyes as 2x NES $30 white pixels, delete isolated 4x4 grey blocks.
3. Region x,y,w,h = 35,178,10,22: make 1X readable. Add 1-pixel NES $30 white outline on left/top of $10 grey body and enlarge eyes to 2x2 white, do not change palette count.
4. Region x,y,w,h = 72,32,112,16: redraw/add a second text row "PRESS START" in 8x8 white $30 on black $0F, centered on 8-pixel grid, to give the frame a verb and test text legibility below title.
5. Region x,y,w,h = 105,13,74,14: move title block left by 8 pixels to x=96 to land on an 8-pixel tile boundary and add 8 pixels top clearance, so nametable placement is clean.

### 6) Scores and machine readable block
NES Authenticity: 7/10
Readability: 5/10
Charm: 2/10
